top_signals.title: Yen Inches Toward 160 Per Dollar, Raising Intervention Concerns
top_signals.summary: The yen edged closer toward a key level against the dollar, raising concerns over Japanese authorities stepping in again to prop up the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
